notes: Account: Summit Harbor Analytics — large fintech providing consumer lending + portfolio analytics. Evaluating Private VPC deployment for regulated inference workloads.
Primary ask: vendor risk intake + completed SIG/CAIQ + clear shared-responsibility diagram for Private VPC. Security team: heavy emphasis on key management, audit trails, and data residency.
Security questionnaire: started SIG OCS preparatory fill; security team requested CAIQ export. We owe them a full CAIQ spreadsheet with evidence links (ISO/SOC2 certs, SOC2 report redacted).

KMS/BYOK: customer requires AWS KMS + external HSM (Thales) support or ability to bring keys. Wants a documented key lifecycle: creation, rotation, deletion, and attestations. Legal pushing for BYOK contract language + HSM attestation.
Network & residency: must keep all inference traffic in US-only regions; VPC peering preferred over public egress; private ENIs or PrivateLink endpoint model desired. No cross-border logging allowed.

Audit & logging: logs need to stream to their Splunk instance over private link; retention policy set to 7+ years for audit logs (per finance regs). Need audit-logging schema and ability to redact PII prior to export.

Shared-responsibility: customer bought up token-level retention vs. platform operational logs. They want explicit mapping: what Redwood retains (runtime logs, health metrics) vs. what customer controls (user prompts, KV cache).

POC ask: 2-week security-enabled POC in customer VPC with a small model (open quantized) to validate KMS flow, audit exports, and latency SLOs. Latency target: p95 <200ms for short chat responses; throughput target ~40 req/s sustained for peak tests.
